full_judgment: 92. In the case of Mullins V s. Treasurer of Surrey (188) 5 Q.B.D. 170 Lush, J. in his celebrated judgment expressed the view:- "When one finds a proviso to a section the natural presumption is that, but for the proviso, the enacting part of the section would have included the subject-matter of the proviso."
